summary: Retested the 2 P0 bug fixes at 390x844 web viewport. RESULT: (1) Signup back button — PASS. [data-testid=auth-back] is visible in BOTH signup and login modes as a floating chevron+'Indietro' pill at top-left (x=12,y=12,101x42px, bg #04091ecc, gold border, z-index 10). Tapping it correctly returns to landing (landing-signin visible again) from both modes. (2) Coverflow scale/opacity — FAIL (P0 still broken visually). The animation formula (scale 1, 0.78, 0.58, 0.42 / opacity 1, 0.75, 0.32, 0.1) IS wired and produces the expected per-position styles, BUT the 'coverflow-center' card (scale=1, opacity=1, width=218px) is rendered at screen cx≈15 (near the LEFT edge, half-clipped by viewport), while the visually-centered card at cx≈195 has scale=0.78 / opacity=0.75 (side-card treatment). So the user sees the ±1 neighbor card as if it were the featured card, and the actual featured card sits partially off-screen to the left. Reproduced consistently at rest AND after every programmatic scroll (scrollBy +360, -180, wheel +500) — every snap position shows the same ~180px offset between coverflow-logic-center and visual-viewport-center. Regression happy path still PASSES end-to-end: login → Explore rail-list → tap card → Champion Detail → svc-video → slot → book-btn → Checkout → pay-btn → Ticket (join-btn) → Call (ctrl-end) → Booking with review-submit. Onboarding 3xAVANTI→INIZIA→landing-signin also PASSES.

ui_bugs.issue: Coverflow effect is off-center by ~180px (~one SNAP width). The card with scale=1/opacity=1 sits at viewport cx≈15 (near left edge, clipped) while cx≈195 (visual center) shows a scale=0.78/opacity=0.75 card. Reproduced at every snap position. See Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CoverflowRail.tsx (lines 49 initial scrollX, 65-70 initialScrollIndex + getItemLayout + snapToInterval, 108-113 distance formula). Observed data at rest: scrollLeft=34200 (=150*SNAP where SNAP=228). Item cr7 (data[0], indices %15==0) is visible at cx=15 with scale=1; adjacent messi at cx=207 with scale=0.78. Hypothesis: mismatch between the animation's assumption that scrollX/SNAP is the visually centered index and the FlatList's actual visual center given contentContainerStyle.paddingHorizontal=SIDE_PAD and snapToInterval=CARD_W+10 with snapToAlignment='center'. Suggested fixes to try: (a) Instead of translating index by scrollX/SNAP directly, use (scrollX + SCREEN_W/2 - SIDE_PAD - CARD_W/2) / SNAP as the effective center-index, i.e. `distance = index - (scrollX + SCREEN_W/2 - SIDE_PAD - CARD_W/2) / snap`. (b) Or replace SNAP=CARD_W+10 with SNAP=CARD_W (0 gap between snap slots) and set paddingHorizontal=(SCREEN_W-CARD_W)/2 exactly, then verify `scrollX/SNAP` at initialScrollIndex=Math.floor(LOOP/2)*data.length actually maps to the visually centered item. (c) Debug by logging both e.contentOffset.x and the actual bounding-rect of the item claimed to be at distance 0 to confirm which index is really visually centered.

critical_code_review_comments: CoverflowRail formula in useAnimatedStyle is correct in isolation (distance = index - scrollX/snap; scale/opacity/translateX interpolations look right), but the assumption that 'scrollX/snap' equals the index of the visually centered item does not hold on RN-Web with the current padding/snap configuration. Add a runtime assertion or a debug prop to verify the mapping.

The Ionicons chevron + 'Indietro' floating back button is well designed: rounded pill with gold border and dark translucent background at top-left inside SafeAreaView, plus 16px hitSlop — clearly visible against the JerseyBackground. onPress resets mode to 'landing' and clears error state. Good implementation.

rca_of_issue: COVERFLOW BUG RCA — Empirical: FlatList scrollLeft = initialScrollIndex*SNAP = 150*228 = 34200, matching the shared scrollX value. The animation formula `distance = index - scrollX/snap` therefore treats the item whose index equals scrollX/snap (=150) as the coverflow center (scale/opacity 1). However, on RN-Web the item that is ACTUALLY visually centered at cx≈195 is not the item at index 150 — it is the item at index 151 (one SNAP to the right). Equivalently, the item at index 150 (scale=1) is being rendered near the left edge at cx≈15. This ~180px offset (~one SNAP width) is consistent across every snap position and every user scroll. Root cause is a mismatch between (i) the FlatList's internal 'centered index at this scrollLeft' — which depends on contentContainerStyle.paddingHorizontal (=SIDE_PAD=86), snapToInterval (=228), snapToAlignment='center', and getItemLayout returning offset=SNAP*i — and (ii) the animation's plain `scrollX/snap` computation which assumes those factors cancel. They don't. Reproduction steps: 1) http://localhost:3000, viewport 390x844. 2) Complete onboarding + sign in with demo creds. 3) On Explore, before scrolling, measure all card-champ-* bounding rects: the one at cx≈195 (screen center) has computed opacity 0.75, the one at cx≈15 has opacity 1. 4) After any snap-scroll, same relationship persists. Mitigation: adjust the animation-space center offset (see suggested fixes a/b/c in ui_bugs.issue).
